_about: The stove-top kitchen's own numbers, the same for every kitchen game.

heat._about: greenRate: from the green on, the heat climbs at this share of the level's rate. overResetMs: how long a spoiled vessel shows before it starts again. holdAt: where in the green a first-time player's heat waits (share of the band). bubbleLead: the boil shows this many seconds before the green, never under bubbleMin. near: the knob is the step from this far below the green.

lines._about: Nani's lines for the kitchen's own steps, as meanings for the language engine. use: put this thing in ($item is the thing). light, turn-down: the knob.

art._about: The kitchen's own pictures, by art id. hob: by how many burners.

layout._about: The play area from above, in design px (a 1600 x 900 sheet; more worktop shows above it on a taller screen). play: the worktop the hob and serving spot are laid out in. hobK: the hob's scale. spot: the serving spot's widest, and gap: its distance from the hob. vesselR: a vessel's widest radius; rim: the rim's share of it. frontStrip: where the hob's front strip sits, by burners. pillRoom: screen px kept above the hob for the count pills. badge, knob, off: the face and knob on the front strip. band: the bottom row's band, base line and pill line; slot: a slot's width; groupGap: between groups; margin: from the view's sides. sizes: a thing's height by size class, as shares of the band's room.

hob._about: How the hob draws the heat and the knob. ring: the ring on the vessel's rim, each layer as [width, colour, strength]; sweep: the heat so far (gold, red past the green); dot: the hand at its end. knob: its angle when off, high and low, and how long it and the flames take to change.

cook._about: The cook scene's small numbers. pointMs: how long the thing the fire needs is pointed at. flameAfterMs: the flame's sound after the knob's click. vesselWiggle: a vessel refusing a tap. ground: the worktop's tiling and its warm wash. countPill: the count pills' place above the hob, in screen px.

lights._about: When the cook scene's first-time lights come, in milliseconds: a control's light a moment after the last movement; a thing's card once the row has settled; the next vessel after a pour. cardMargin: px round a lit card.

steam._about: Steam over a vessel at the boil, in vessel-rim radii and milliseconds: a wisp every so often, rising and fading; two puffs at a boil-over.
